description:
Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.

As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

The Data Partnerships Manager is the single, accountable owner of primary-source data acquisition and reliable accessibility: identifying and prioritizing which sources matter most, running the outreach and negotiation to secure access, and handing off cleanly to Verification Operations and Data Solutions for integration.

Our work is mission-critical to the healthcare workforce and depends on accurate, timely primary-source licensure and credential data, and on strong working relationships with the licensing boards, certifying bodies, and national organizations that maintain it.

This role is deliberately scoped to focus primarily on data acquisition. The Data Partnerships Manager partners closely with Customer Success and Government Relationships to draw on warm introductions and intelligence, and thoughtfully engage and guide a process through a healthy data agreement’s execution.

The ideal candidate is personable, driven, detail-oriented, a strong communicator, and has strong negotiation skills; can run many conversations at once without dropping any, and ideally already has a network across state licensing and healthcare regulation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Source Strategy & Pipeline Ownership

  • Build and own the single, company-wide centralized pipeline and dashboard of target licensing boards, certifying bodies, national organizations, and state data portals for new primary-source data access for all internal teams to work from.

  • Maintain market intelligence on how boards and states share data (open-data initiatives, state portals, legislative and policy shifts, vendor landscape), drawing on External Affairs' regulatory monitoring rather than duplicating it, and translate it into pipeline priority calls.

Outreach, Negotiation & Deal Execution

  • Lead proactive outreach to sources with no existing Propelus relationship.

  • Negotiate data access agreements that secure direct, reliable, well-structured access on a defined cadence. Structure agreements that deliver clear, fair value to each source, consistent with its statutes, procurement rules, and public-records requirements.

  • Own drafting, redlines, budget approval, and contract submission through Ironclad in partnership with Legal and Finance;

  • Handoff & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate before first outreach whenever a target board is a CE Broker prospect or existing account, so Propelus shows up with one voice; hand the relationship back to the CE Broker Customer Success team once the data agreement is signed and live.

  • Define the integration spec (format, fields, delivery method, cadence) with each new source and hand off cleanly to Verification Operations and Data Solutions for technical evaluation, build, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Lead initial outreach on data access disruptions at boards with no existing CE Broker in partnership with cross-functiaonl teams.

Operating Discipline & Reporting

  • Stand up and run a formal pipeline process in the company CRM (HubSpot), replacing ad hoc tracking with defined deal stages, activity logging, and pipeline reporting leadership can rely on.

  • Own and report monthly on outcomes: sources secured and integrated, pipeline volume and stage progression, average cost per source, and time from first contact to live integration. Use these metrics to shorten deal cycles over time.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Negotiation: Proven ability to negotiate complex, non-standard agreements where the value exchange goes beyond price, and to get to “yes” with counterparts who have no obligation to say it.

  • Sales discipline: Comfortable owning a pipeline end to end, living in a CRM daily (HubSpot preferred), and holding yourself to targets for activity, conversion, and cycle time.

  • Experience: 5+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, or enterprise sales operations, with a record of personally sourcing and closing agreements with public-sector, regulatory, or data-provider counterparts. This is a deal-closing role, not a monitoring or advisory one.

  • Public-sector fluency: Understands how state agencies operate — procurement rules, budget cycles, data-sharing and public-records limits — and what shapes their decisions.

  • Organization and follow-through: Able to manage dozens of concurrent conversations at different stages without losing track of commitments or deadlines.

  • Communication: Clear, persuasive writing and speaking, adjusted for each audience: from board executive directors and IT staff to legal counsel and Propelus executives.

  • Technical literacy: Able to discuss data formats, APIs, file transfers, and data security requirements with credibility. You will not build the integration, but you know what a good one requires.

  • Builder mindset: You are energized by standing up a new function, bringing structure to an ever-evolving space, and acting with urgency and ownership.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD:

  • Network: Existing relationships with state licensing boards, healthcare regulators, state agencies, or regulatory associations.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: A record of success in matrixed environments, including the judgment to route work to External Affairs or CE Broker Customer Success rather than working around them.

  • Healthcare and regulatory alignment: Experience in healthcare credentialing, professional licensure, primary source verification, background screening, or health data.

  • System Operating Knowledge: Familiarity with Ironclad or comparable contract management tools, and with the privacy and security requirements in data-use agreements (SOC 2, state data-sharing rules).

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU:

  • Love to move fast and juggle several projects in different stages of progress while maintaining strong relationships with various stakeholders.

  • Are adept at getting others to cooperate and understand your perspective; you are naturally a people person and enjoy building relationships with others.

  • Are proactive, confident, and a natural leader who excels at creating systems and

    processes that drive success.

  • You communicate quickly, factually, and in detail, and you enjoy working directly with people to solve their problems.

THIS MAY NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU:

  • Are not someone who enjoys being a problem solver and loves working with both data and people.

  • Aren't able to identify the order in chaotic environments and implement the strategies to create structure.

  • Want a more traditional and competitive sales position.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in healthcare and are focused on hiring individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to support us in doing good, what’s human, and making a difference.

Benefits and Perks for Propelus Employees

US Employees:

  • Health Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the premium for employee medical insurance. Plans for spouses and children are made affordable through Propelus’ generous contribution

    • Employees can choose from HSA, FSA, and traditional insurance options for medical, dental, and vision coverage for themselves and dependents.

    • Dental and Vision plans, both including an option with 100% of the premium covered for employees

  • Generous PTO:

    • Accrual: (full-time US): 0–4 yrs 20 days | 5–9 yrs 25 days. | 10+ yrs 30 days per year (accrues quarterly: Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1; and is available immediately).

    • US-based teams observe 14 paid holidays each year

    • Floating Holiday: One floating holiday is yours to request on any day of your choice. This is separate from your PTO.

    • Birthday Holiday: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get 1 paid day off during your birth month, separate from your PTO.

    • Volunteer Time Off: 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you.

    • Additional leave options: to support you in embracing life centricity

    • State & local leave laws

      • Where state or local leave laws provide additional protections, Propelus will comply with whichever regulation is more favorable to the employee.

  • 401K with company matching, as well as financial planning education and resources.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): We support personal well-being by offering an annual lifestyle spending account that you can use for what matters most to you—whether it’s a gym membership, a meditation app, WFH equipment, or fresh produce delivered to your door. Think of it as a bonus for the expenses and experiences you value most.

  • Employee Assistance Programs: provides 24/7/365 support by phone and online — family clinical counseling, legal & financial services, plus child and elder care referrals.

  • Carrot Fertility & Hormonal Support: Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family-building benefits with funds toward eligible care.

  • Beyond Med: A licensed discount plan organization (DPO) giving you access to elective care like acupuncture, dermatology, fertility, GLP-1, and more — at discounted rates.

  • Spot Pet Insurance: A financial safety net for your furry family. Get reimbursed for emergencies, lab fees, behavior, x-rays, surgeries, cancer, and more.

LATAM (Costa Rica and Colombia) Employees:

  • Your health is our top priority! We cover 100% of employee health insurance premiums. Our plans include national and international coverage, so you're protected no matter where you are.

  • Propelus Flex Club: Our flexible benefits platform gives you monthly points to redeem on what you need most. Plus, you'll get access to exclusive discounts just for being part of our team. (Details are country specific)

  • Generous PTO:

    • National Holidays (Colombia): 18 days

    • National Holidays (Costa Rica): 12 days

    • Birthday Holiday: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get 1 paid day off during your birth month, separate from your PTO.

    • Volunteer Time Off: 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you.

    • We've got you covered with a life insurance policy, paid 100% by the company. You can also add your beneficiaries at an exclusive, discounted rate.

    • Carrot Fertility & Hormonal Support: Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family-building benefits with funds toward eligible care.

Benefits and Perks for ALL Propelus employees include but are not limited to:

A remote first company, global and distributed, with two office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery.

  • Employees celebrating their 10 and 20 year work anniversary are eligible to take a trip sponsored by Propelus within one year of their 10th and 20th anniversary date.

  • Awarded one of BuiltIn's 2025 Best Places to Work and honored as a Silver Stevie® Award Winner in the 2025 Stevie Awards For Great Employers.

  • Professional development allowance to help you grow in the ways that mean the most to you.

  • Check us out for yourself at our careers page or our Propelus culture Instagram accounts.

Typical Interview Process:

  • Interview #1: Brief intro screen with our People Ops team

  • Interview #2: Introduction with the Hiring Manager

  • Interview #3: Team Panel

  • Interview #4: Alignment interview with Senior Leadership

If you don’t move forward to the next round, we’ll make sure you know as soon as possible.

Tips for applicants: Focus on your application. At Propelus, everyone has an equal opportunity based on their merit. Reaching out to the team or providing referrals will not change your chances.

We work remotely and communicate asynchronously, so writing is a key skill at Propelus. Please answer the application questions with your own thoughtful responses. Replies like "See resume" or N/A won't lead to an interview. Have some fun with it, we actually read these!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Propelus. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Full-time positions are scheduled to work 40 hours per week, M-F unless required otherwise by projects. Part-time positions are scheduled to work a maximum of 30 hours per week. Equipment, benefits, and perks are not provided to part-time or temporary employees.
